correctness.rationale: The full star bracket presentation in arXiv:2610.33963v1 yields ad_x^2(c)=-T_u(u), ad_x^2(v)=tT_u(v) and zero on the higher graded layers. Solving all equations u_i v_j+u_j v_i=0 by support proves the characteristic-dependent ranks over any field; exact support counting proves the polynomial, and conditional rank-nullity proves the Engel probability and asymptotics. The verifier independently constructs the Lie multiplication matrices and tests 1,477 parameter profiles including an F4 extension-field case; 535,537 ordered pairs are also directly checked in two small fields. Finite tests are not used as a universal proof.

value.rationale: The second Engel word law is a standard natural nonidentity in class-three Lie algebras. The finding classifies all ranks of squared inner adjoint maps on a canonical infinite graph-Lie family and derives exact finite-field probabilities and densities. It reveals a genuine characteristic-two structural bifurcation, with 2-Engel pair limits q^{-1} versus q^{-2}; these data are not provided by the motivating paper’s structural dimensions or generic Engel-law thresholds.
